sources.weakCentral: GAME_DESIGN §23 / TEST_PLAN: goleiro defende chute fraco central (nunca ignorar chute fraco central). A ground ball from the penalty spot at a weak speed, straight at the goal centre
sources.outOfReach: TEST_PLAN: não alcança fora do alcance. Keeper on one post, hard shot from close range to the far corner: GkDiveReach (<= 3 m) can never cover it
sources.plausibility: ROADMAP A6 aceite: goleiro plausível em partidas. Shots on target the keeper has time to react to (predicted arrival at least minArrivalSeconds after the shot) are mostly saved; point-blank shots are not judged here (1x1 rush is out of A6). DESIGN ESTIMATE: real keepers save ~65-75% of shots on target
